lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the pectoral fin. Vertical clusters of 3 to 4 blobs form a repeating pattern along the mid-lateral line, with local maxima spaced approximately equidistantly in a staggered arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal carinae, forming a grid where high-luminance blobs act as anchor nodes at the intersection points, most prominent in the central third of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with peak intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and significant shadowing immediately ventral to the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance spots, significantly smaller and more closely packed than those on the lateral flank.
